name: Cat, Maine Coon, Silver Tabby - Figurine Pet Cremation Urn
description: Our figurine cremation urns are the perfect way to display your love for your cat, dog or other special friend. Each figurine is hand-painted and finished with great detail.Quality Solid Hardwood in 4 Different SizesAll figurine urns are made from quality solid hardwood and are available in your choice of oak, walnut or maple. The bottom of the urns are covered in a soft black felt which will help prevent damage when placed on delicate surfaces such as wood or glass.Optional Engraved PlateThe optional engraving plate is made from a premium leaded brass and is 2.75" wide by 1.125" high. Plates can be up to 4 lines long with 25 characters available on each line (100 characters total). Our experienced engravers will layout the engraving to achieve the best appearance.Bottom Tamper-Resistant OpeningThe bottom of the urn is sealed securely through the use of several screws. The cremains you received from your crematory in a bag can be transferred easily into the figurine urn.
